{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "Outer coat is not permitted as the temperature is well above the threshold for needing an outer layer.

A structured wool blend blazer in #2a2326 with a tailored fit reaching the hip, paired with high-waisted dark denim trousers in #1f1c1f cut straight and ending just at the ankle.
Footwear consists of sleek black leather ankle boots in #0e0e0e with a low block heel for traction on salted snowy streets.
This outfit works because it adheres to her wish for everyday formal wear while respecting the cold weather constraint by omitting an unnecessary outer layer since she will only be walking for twenty minutes, yet the dark denim and structured jacket provide enough warmth and sophistication for a professional morning arrival without looking like a full work suit."}
